statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of six representative public content/navigation templates plus an HTTP failure state. External age-verification, authenticated account, payment/subscription and post-verification media playback were not traversed; their public handoffs were inspected. Repeated catalog URLs sharing these templates were intentionally de-duplicated.

page.framework: Server-rendered MPA with bundled JavaScript (no framework signature detected)
page.notes: Public adult-media catalog. Content is fully server-rendered; age verification is an external OAuth handoff. Distinct homepage, listing, category, search, video and photo templates were sampled.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared default/dark screenshots and inspected computed/authored CSS.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The palette is unchanged, color-scheme is normal, and no preference rule exists.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion:reduce and inspected document animations.
checkOutcomes.evidence: document.getAnimations() returned an empty list, so there is no non-essential motion to suppress on the representative entry state.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured the page under forced-colors:active and prefers-contrast:more.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Text, navigation, age notice and content cards remain visible with system colors in the forced-colors screenshot.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected authored CSS and interaction recording.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No View Transition opt-in or rules are present; state/navigation changes are immediate.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS and representative pages for scroll-linked effects.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site has no parallax, scrollytelling, reveal, carousel or other scroll-linked motion to implement.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked animation exists on the representative templates.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected mobile interaction surfaces and CSS.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The site uses ordinary links, grids and a menu; there is no swipe, drag, pull-to-reveal or carousel gesture.
checkOutcomes.reason: No gesture-driven component exists in the audited templates.

checkOutcomes.method: Scrolled the desktop page 1,200px and compared header geometry.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The non-sticky header moves fully out of view (top -1200px), yielding the viewport to content rather than leaving static chrome affixed.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected DOM/CSS and exercised available entry controls.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, anchored menu or edge-sensitive popover is present on the representative pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: No anchored overlay exists to position.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared listing/search screenshots and navigation state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Current sections and sort modes use contrasting text/underline states (for example RELEVANCE on search), and headings immediately identify the destination.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first-load desktop and mobile screenshots.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The legally required age-verification notice is inline, clearly labelled and does not obscure content; no full-viewport popup appears on load.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected DOM semantics for menu/account overlays.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No dialog/popover/details exists; menu is a div and account controls use JS popup hooks.

checkOutcomes.method: Visually compared desktop/mobile content-to-chrome balance.
checkOutcomes.evidence: After the compact header/search/notice, the viewport is dominated by content grids or the primary detail surface, with minimal framing.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured 360×800 pages and measured scrollWidth vs clientWidth.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile layout reports 360px scrollWidth and clientWidth with 0px overflow; home and detail reflow into a single-column layout.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected fetched CSS and wide/narrow renderings.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No @container/container-type is present; changes are viewport-driven.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected focus, semantics and target dimensions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Menu lacks keyboard semantics, focus indicator is absent and targets fail sizing.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first viewports and headings across six templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Each template has a specific title/H1 and exposes search, content cards, category links or the verification/player action without decorative preamble.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected and exercised search results and inspected playback handoff.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search completes, but the apparent primary player is a fake same-page link with an external verification URL rather than an explicit, named step.

checkOutcomes.method: Requested a representative invalid route and inspected its rendered state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The route shows only a stock nginx 404 and provides no recovery action.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse and a DevTools trace.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse mobile LCP was 2,594.5ms, above the 2,500ms good threshold; trace desktop LCP was 1,803ms, CLS/TBT were good.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured layout shifts with layout primitive and Lighthouse.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Layout primitive observed CLS 0 with no shifts; Lighthouse measured CLS 0.0000439.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured trace and Lighthouse main-thread metrics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace found one 51.75ms task and only 1.75ms TBT; Lighthouse TBT was 12.5ms, indicating responsive main-thread behavior.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR, confirmed script attributes in DOM, and inspected BFCache diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Two parser-inserted classic scripts lack async/defer and no-store policies block BFCache.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse unused-code diagnostics and HAR byte analysis.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 220,263B unused JS and 24,145B unused CSS; analytics bundles dominate script bytes.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran axe/Lighthouse and inspected menu/player DOM.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search button lacks a discernible name; menu is a non-semantic div and player link is unnamed.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran axe color-contrast analysis.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Two normal-text surfaces measure 3.74:1 and 2.58:1, below 4.5:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran axe and direct focus/landmark probes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No main landmark exists across representative templates and a focused visible link has no outline or shadow.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed desktop/mobile screenshots and zoom/reflow layout.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Headings, card titles and metadata remain readable without clipping at 360px; text columns are short and aligned to cards.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse target-size audit and inspected mobile player control.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Footer targets are 16px high/too closely spaced; icon search is 30px and the fake player has no named media action.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse errors-in-console audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console scored 1 with an empty items list.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran DOM/image audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 70/72 images lack srcset, 71 use legacy formats and six lack explicit dimensions.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse best-practices diagnostics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: BFCache is blocked by no-store/WebSocket behavior and an Inspector cookie issue was logged.

checkOutcomes.method: Probed title and meta description on six representative templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage, listing, category, search, video and photo detail each expose a descriptive title and non-empty description.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected anchors, viewport and robots; ran Lighthouse SEO/discoverability.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Real href links, viewport metadata and a permissive public robots policy are present; Lighthouse SEO scored 1.0 and raw content coverage is 100%.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected status, canonical, robots and sitemap signals.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative public pages returned content with self-referencing canonicals; robots permits them and advertises a current sitemap index.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected JSON-LD and social tags across representative templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tested template contains JSON-LD; only video detail exposes Open Graph data.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran headers and cookies primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: CSP/nosniff/referrer/permissions policies are missing; session cookie is not HttpOnly and multiple cookies lack Secure.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran HAR, tracker and cookie primitives before interaction.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Google and Yandex tracking starts immediately across six non-page origins, with no prior consent UI.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected account controls, page scripts and load-time behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt fired on load, but login/sign-up surfaces expose no WebAuthn/passkey path and depend on JavaScript popup links with no URL fallback.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected browser security headers and cookie posture.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HSTS/X-Frame-Options exist, but CSP/frame-ancestors policy, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared fetched raw HTML with rendered DOM and crawler screenshot.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Discoverability measured 100% content coverage, with title, H1 and description in raw HTML and no empty JS mount.

checkOutcomes.method: Exercised repeated mobile menu toggles and inspected narrow layouts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Menu toggling returned to its initial collapsed state after ten cycles; mobile screenshots show no clipped core controls or horizontal overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected manifest and service-worker registration.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A display manifest exists but no service worker is registered; this public streaming/catalog site is intrinsically network-dependent and does not present itself as an offline app.
checkOutcomes.reason: Offline playback and installability are not a reasonable core requirement for this network-dependent media catalog.

checkOutcomes.method: Requested invalid route and inspected response page.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Stock nginx 404 provides no recovery UI.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected html attributes and stylesheet property usage.
checkOutcomes.evidence: lang=en is correct, but no logical properties/dir strategy exists and 262 physical declarations were found.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed rendered locale-sensitive values and alternate-language entry point.
checkOutcomes.evidence: English pages use human-readable relative durations such as “12 years ago” and compact counts consistently; a dedicated German locale host is exposed.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected representative content for absolute times, events and scheduling.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited catalog exposes relative publication ages and media durations, not appointments, recurring events or user-entered zoned timestamps.
checkOutcomes.reason: No time-zone-sensitive workflow or scheduled event exists in the audited templates.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed age, promo and account surfaces visually.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The age requirement is stated plainly, the outbound offer is labelled [PROMO], and no preselected purchase, confirmshaming or forced-continuity control appeared.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected all visible forms and attempted account entry.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The only directly available form is optional search with no invalid/required state; no authored data-entry validation flow is exposed before the external/gated account path.
checkOutcomes.reason: No directly exercisable required-input form exists in the audited public flow.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected the public search input attributes and behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The search field has a descriptive placeholder, query name, server-resolvable action and site autocomplete suggestions; it successfully produced a query-specific result page.

checkOutcomes.method: Attempted visible account entry and inspected link/form semantics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Account links are href="#" JavaScript hooks and exposed no URL fallback or semantic dialog.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran image and network asset audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 71/72 images are legacy format and 70 lack responsive candidates on a media-heavy page.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared tracker/HAR activity and Lighthouse bootup work.
checkOutcomes.evidence: GTM, gtag, Yandex and ad code duplicate initial background/network work.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured five-second HAR and grouped bytes by origin/type.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 841KB is attributed off the exact page origin, with analytics scripts among the largest resources before media engagement.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected markup/scripts for agent tool registration and judged site intent.
checkOutcomes.evidence: This public browse-and-play catalog exposes crawlable links and SearchAction metadata but no agent-facing transaction/tool surface that requires WebMCP.
checkOutcomes.reason: No declared or evident agent-executable capability is in scope; emerging WebMCP absence is not penalised.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected scripts and page capabilities for built-in AI use cases.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation, generation or language-model feature is offered where on-device inference would improve the current core flow.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited experience has no inference feature to execute locally or remotely.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared mobile baseline/post heaps and ran a same-session ten-cycle menu test.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Heap self size changed from 12.50MB baseline to 12.86MB post in separate equivalent loads; same-session DOM nodes stayed exactly 1,418 and measured used heap decreased 195KB after ten cycles.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured heap snapshot and performance.memory on the content-dense homepage.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile baseline heap self size was 12.50MB with 227,719 heap nodes; runtime used heap was about 8–10MB, proportionate to a 1,418-element media grid.

checkOutcomes.method: Repeated the menu interaction ten times and compared DOM/heap totals.
checkOutcomes.evidence: DOM node count remained 1,418 with no retained DOM growth; equivalent post heap growth was only ~0.35MB and no accumulating UI nodes were observed.

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged not applicable to this site.

paths.description: Homepage and global navigation; entry, age-verification notice, search, content grids, desktop/mobile and preference conditions.
Most-viewed video listing, representing paginated video index templates.
Video detail and gated playback handoff, the primary content-consumption archetype.
A-Z category index, representing taxonomy/navigation pages.
Search results for “test”, exercising the primary discovery flow from query to results.
Photo album detail, representing the distinct image-gallery template.
Representative invalid route to inspect HTTP/network failure recovery.

findings.summary: The dark palette is hard-coded rather than integrated with the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The default and prefers-color-scheme:dark screenshots are byte-identical; computed color-scheme is “normal”, and fetched CSS contains no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() so browser UI and site surfaces follow the user’s theme.

findings.summary: Navigation and state changes use abrupt swaps with no View Transition integration.
findings.evidence: The authored stylesheet probe found no view-transition rules and the transition support probe reported no page opt-in.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-document transitions for tab/panel state and cross-document View Transitions for compatible page navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Core controls are not reliably keyboard- or touch-friendly.
findings.evidence: The mobile menu is a plain <div class="menu-btn"> with no role, tabindex or accessible name; the first focused link computed to outline:none, and Lighthouse found undersized footer targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real button for the menu with an accessible name and expanded state, provide visible :focus-visible styles, and enlarge/space small targets.

findings.summary: Menu and account-popup controls use ad-hoc elements and JavaScript hooks instead of semantic platform primitives.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found no dialog, popover or details elements; the mobile menu is a clickable div and account links use href="#" plus js-popup handlers.
findings.suggestedFix: Use button + popover for transient navigation and <dialog> for modal sign-in, with declarative commands and light dismiss.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is viewport-only; reusable cards and navigation do not adapt to their container.
findings.evidence: Fetched authored CSS contains no @container or container-type while the layout switches from five columns to one only at the viewport level.
findings.suggestedFix: Define containment on reusable grids/cards and move local breakpoints to size container queries.

findings.summary: The not-found state is a dead end with no recovery path.
findings.evidence: The invalid route returns only the nginx “404 Not Found” page and contains zero links, search, home navigation, or retry guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404 that preserves global navigation, explains the state, offers search and links back to useful content.

findings.summary: Mobile lab LCP narrowly misses the good Core Web Vitals threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 2,594.5ms, just above the 2,500ms good threshold; CLS was 0.00004 and TBT 12.5ms. A separate desktop trace measured LCP 1,803ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP element and reduce document/third-party startup latency so mobile LCP remains below 2.5s.

findings.summary: Parser-inserted scripts and cache policy weaken repeat-navigation performance.
findings.evidence: HAR+DOM confirmation found bundle.js and ogr/xd.js parser-inserted without async/defer/module; Lighthouse reports the main resource/no-store policy prevents BFCache.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts, split critical from optional behavior, and avoid no-store where private state does not require it so BFCache can work.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused JavaScript and CSS, much of it in analytics stacks.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 220,263 bytes of unused JavaScript and 24,145 bytes of unused CSS; its bootup breakdown includes GTM, gtag, Yandex and ad code.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics loaders, conditionally load optional scripts, and split page-specific CSS/JS.

findings.summary: Important interactive controls lack accessible names and semantics.
findings.evidence: axe and Lighthouse both report the icon-only search button has no discernible name; the mobile menu is a non-focusable div, and the video’s fake-player link has no text or aria-label.
findings.suggestedFix: Use semantic buttons and add concise accessible names; expose menu expanded state and give the gated player link an explicit action label.

findings.summary: Secondary and footer text fail WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: axe measured 3.74:1 for age-verification subtext and 2.58:1 for copyright text, below the required 4.5:1 for normal text.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise foreground lightness or darken the surfaces until normal text reaches at least 4.5:1 in every state.

findings.summary: Landmark structure and visible keyboard focus are missing.
findings.evidence: axe reports no main landmark and content outside landmarks; all six representative templates reported main:false, and a programmatically focused visible link computed to outline:none and box-shadow:none.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in <main>, use semantic header/nav/footer landmarks, and add a strong :focus-visible indicator with logical tab order.

findings.summary: Some controls are undersized and the gated player action is not exposed as an understandable media control.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identified 16px-high footer links with inadequate spacing; the search control is 30×30px and the video preview is a textless link rather than a named play/verification control.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 24×24 CSS px targets with spacing (prefer 44×44 for primary touch controls) and make the player action a named control; provide captions when media is served.

findings.summary: Image delivery is based almost entirely on fixed legacy assets without responsive candidates.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 70/72 images without srcset, 71 legacy-format images, six without explicit dimensions and one oversized asset across the content-heavy homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height, responsive srcset/sizes, and AVIF/WebP sources while retaining an appropriate fallback.

findings.summary: The page blocks BFCache and logs a browser cookie issue.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports BFCache blocked by no-store responses and WebSocket use, plus an Inspector cookie issue from Yandex resources.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove avoidable no-store responses and close/suspend background connections on pagehide; update third-party cookie integrations.

findings.summary: Rich content templates omit structured data, and only video details provide Open Graph metadata.
findings.evidence: Probes found zero JSON-LD blocks on homepage, listing, category, video and photo templates; the video has Open Graph tags but no VideoObject, while listing/photo templates expose no share metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org VideoObject/ImageGallery/BreadcrumbList JSON-LD and complete Open Graph/Twitter metadata that matches visible content.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced security defenses and cookie flags are incomplete.
findings.evidence: HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent. PHPSESSID is not HttpOnly; multiple cookies lack Secure and use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, nosniff, strict referrer and permissions policies; mark session cookies Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: Analytics and cookie syncing begin immediately with a broad tracking footprint.
findings.evidence: The tracker probe found Google Analytics/GTM and Yandex across six non-page origins; the HAR recorded 57/60 requests off the exact main origin and 841KB transferred, while no consent control was visible before these requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not load non-essential analytics before consent, remove duplicate analytics stacks, disable cookie syncing, and proxy/self-host only what is justified.

findings.summary: HTTP failure handling drops users into an unstyled server page.
findings.evidence: The attempted invalid route displayed the stock nginx 404 with no preserved context, links, retry, search or home action.
findings.suggestedFix: Route 404/5xx responses through a lightweight server-rendered recovery template and preserve useful navigation even without JavaScript.

findings.summary: The localized site’s stylesheet is not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: The page correctly declares lang="en" and links to a German host, but fetched CSS has no logical properties and contains 262 physical left/right declarations; no dir strategy is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce dir-aware markup and migrate component geometry to logical inline/block properties so localized layouts can support bidi and writing-mode changes.

findings.summary: Account entry points rely on empty hash links and an opaque JavaScript popup path.
findings.evidence: Visible Log in and Sign up anchors use href="#" with data-page/js-popup hooks; an attempted click did not expose a dialog or form in the inspected state, so the path has no URL fallback.
findings.suggestedFix: Give account actions real fallback URLs, use a semantic dialog only as an enhancement, and ensure sign-in forms support correct autocomplete and modern authentication.

findings.summary: The primary playback action is presented as a fake player link with an indirect verification handoff.
findings.evidence: The detail page contains no video element; its apparent player is an unnamed anchor to the same page with a data-avs-link to an external age-verification OAuth flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Present age verification as an explicit, named step before a real player, explain the external handoff and return path, and avoid styling a navigation link as a player control.

findings.summary: Multiple analytics stacks and ad code perform redundant background work on initial load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse bootup attributes work to GTM, gtag, Yandex and adlib; the tracker probe shows overlapping analytics vendors and the HAR records repeated Yandex cookie-sync redirects.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose one minimal analytics path, batch necessary events, defer it until consent/idle, and remove cookie-sync/ad work that does not serve the core task.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts dominate transferred bytes before the user engages with media.
findings.evidence: The HAR measured 841KB attributed off the exact page origin; GTM/gtag/Yandex scripts are among the largest resources, while actual page images transferred about 322KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, defer analytics and ads, and load media/marketing dependencies only after user intent.

taskList.title: Harden response headers and all session/analytics cookie flags
Gate and minimize analytics/tracking; remove duplicate vendors and cookie sync
Rebuild menu, search and player actions with semantic named controls and visible focus
Provide explicit, recoverable age-verification/playback and account handoffs
Modernize responsive image formats, dimensions and srcset
Reduce mobile LCP and restore BFCache by reprioritizing scripts/cache policy
Add accurate rich-content JSON-LD and social metadata
Adopt logical properties and component container queries
Add preference-aware theming and View Transitions with motion fallback
